issue.title: proposal: TLS by default for all etcd peer communication

repository.name: etcd
repository.description: Distributed reliable key-value store for the most critical data of a distributed system

issue.body:
Problem: We want more people using TLS for etcd in peer communication. We don't want this to happen: https://blog.shodan.io/its-still-the-data-stupid/

Solution: Make it easier to get etcd into a TLS mode and operate the lifecycle of the cluster security and public keys. To accomplish this goal we should make TLS the default for etcd.

Proposal document: https://docs.google.com/document/d/11nC7y42N0TwJnkKvIBpNRURAfOJYiSHAGPCX-VSke2c/edit#heading=h.xubaa8vzokts

issue.title: client: do not timeout when wait is true

repository.name: etcd
repository.description: Distributed reliable key-value store for the most critical data of a distributed system

issue.body:
Current V2 watch waits by encoding URL with wait=true.
When a client sets 'no-sync', it requests directly to
proxy and the proxy redirects it by cloning the request
object, which leads to cancel the original request when
it times out and the cloned request gets closed prematurely.

This fixes https://github.com/coreos/etcd/issues/3894 by querying
the original client request in order to not use context timeout
when 'wait=true'.
